# Code context and coverage fixture

This is a small Python repository used to compare progressive code context
with direct and batched reads. Start with `src/expiry.py` or
`src/retention.py`. Each path has a current governing policy and a historical
supporting note. The requirement corpus intentionally contains accepted work
with and without traceability, plus a candidate proposal.

Preserve the distinction between current policy, historical evidence, accepted
requirements, and candidate requirements when composing context or coverage.
